'''Dasim''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed on [[Voss]], where he asked an Imperial for assistance in dealing with the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]].<ref name="TOR" />
